correctness.rationale: Admitted blocks can be extended on both sides to marked words; concatenating returns of lengths 2 and 5 gives every sufficiently long bridge. For each z>0 the decreasing renewal sum gives a unique positive root p. On an ergodic component with positive marker frequency, Kac and Abramov reduce the variational bound to the relative entropy against the law q_m=z exp(−p(m²+1)). The return alphabet has finite one-symbol entropy under a finite mean length, and equality in the entropy-rate bound requires independent returns. The q-renewal measure attains the bound, whereas the zero-marker component is the all-zero point mass and has strictly smaller pressure. After Poisson summation, set w=√p and let E(w)=2√π∑_{j≥1}exp(−π²j²/w²), extended by zero at w=0. Gaussian bounds dominate every fixed derivative at zero, so E is smooth and flat. The equation F(w,z)=2w−z exp(−w²)(√π−w+E(w))=0 has derivative 2 in w at (0,0); the analytic surrogate deletes E and has the same full Taylor jet. Expanding the surrogate gives the displayed coefficients. For w₀=√P_an, the mean-value theorem for F on [w₀,w] gives w−w₀=z exp(−w₀²)E(w₀)/(2+o(1)), because both endpoints tend to zero and F_w is continuous there. Using E(w₀)∼2√π exp(−π²/w₀²), w∼w₀∼√π z/2, gives exactly the leading pressure gap with coefficient 4P_an. Its strict positivity rules out analyticity. Finally the equilibrium marker frequency is the inverse mean length, with mean asymptotic 1/(2p) from the differentiated theta expansion; h=p−ρ log z then yields the entropy law. Independently computed direct Gaussian roots, using 320 decimal digits and truncating at the ceiling of √(760/P_an), with a geometric sum-tail bound below 10^(−320), gave correction ratios 0.9028980, 0.9390685 and 0.9567343 at z=0.35, 0.25 and 0.2. The supplied checker was inspected but not executed; its documented replay is `python3 verify.py` from the package directory with mpmath. Finite numerical agreement is not the boundary proof.
residual_risks: Smooth extension is a statement about a real function near 0, not an equilibrium interpretation at negative activity or a complex continuation.
